description: A writable signal whose value is recomputed (and overrides manual writes) when its source changes.
`linkedSignal(() => expr)`: every signal read in `expr` is a source.
`linkedSignal({ source, computation: (value, previous) => ... })`: only `source` is tracked; `previous` holds the old source and value.
`undefined` on the first computation, then `{ source, value }`, where `value` includes manual `set()` calls.
`draft = linkedSignal(() => this.user().name)`: local edits that reset when the input changes.
